dataset.title: Proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) data
dataset.description: The dataset includes data related to the effectiveness of proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) as photo-theranostic materials for fluorescence imaging and photothermal therapies. The data will be made available to interested investigators for scientific research. The data must be withheld long enough to enable peer review and publication/dissemination or protection of intellectual property. Confidential material will be handled according to policies and protocols at UCR, Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), and any other applicable regulations and restrictions. All materials uploaded to the eScholarship site will be tagged uniformly with metadata about the source and nature of the data. Any electronic file format (e.g., text, spreadsheets, images) can be accepted. The data will be made available for a minimum of three years after conclusion of the award or public release, whichever is later.

dataset.title: General research data
dataset.description: Data obtained and this study will be made available to the research community. The data will be made available through a custom data management system combining an eScholarship series and EZID permanent identifiers for long-term identification and management of data resources. The data will be searchable through databases and search engines, including Google and Google Scholar. The data will be provided to any national resources and or databases on nanoparticles that compile and maintain such information, such as the nanotechnology information library (NIL) (http://nanoparticlelibrary.net/index.asp).

dataset.title: Project results and findings
dataset.description: The project results and findings will be published and presented in relevant conferences, workshops, seminars, and teaching forums. The data will be made available to the research community, subject to policies and protocols adopted by the relevant Institutional Research Board (IRB) and the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) regulations. Confidential material will be handled according to policies and protocols at UCR, Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), and any other applicable regulations and restrictions.

project.title: Research on Nano-vesicles (NETs) as photo-theranostic materials
project.description: This project aims to determine the effectiveness of proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) as photo-theranostic materials for fluorescence imaging and photothermal therapies. The study will involve collecting and assessing environmental data and will support sustainable urban planning initiatives and inform conservation strategies.
